# Fitting D-bores and the cone gear stack {#sec-soldering}

MHA-014 has one co-clocked D-flat on each gear land. The 64T and all twenty cone gears
slide onto matching D-bores; the gears touch from the thrust-collar-supported 64T
to T006. This is a 2026-09-28 user ruling for alignment without adhesive, not
the photographed original: the p.21 macro shows solder blobs on the small gears.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**TODO(cut it first)** — the D-bore finishing and gauging operation has not been logged;
this is a fit specification, not a proved machining sequence.
:::

## Check the flats and bores

The shaft AF values are 8.763, 5.842, 2.921 and 1.460 mm, each +0/−0.010 mm.
Each matching D-bore AF is +0.010/+0.020 mm over its shaft nominal (0.01–0.03 mm
flat clearance); the round portions have 0.025–0.105 mm diametral slip clearance.
These values come from `cad/scripts/cone_shaft_land_bands.py` and
`cad/scripts/gear_seat_fit.py`. **TODO(cut it first):** the D-bore production method
has not yet been recorded in `logbook/entries/`; no cutter, feed or setup is prescribed here.

## Fit the solid stack

The 64T is 7.2113 ±0.025 mm thick. The twenty cone gears are each
6.8887 ±0.025 mm thick; check the twenty-gear stack at **137.774 ±0.20 mm**
(`cad/scripts/cone_gear_stack.py`). The tip bushing bears on T006. Set the tip
block against a 0.45 mm feeler off the bushing; the end-play window is
0.35–0.55 mm (`cad/scripts/cone_stack_end_play.py`). The 16T pinion face is
9.5 mm (`cad/scripts/crank_pinion_spec.py`). The tip bushing retains its
round bore but acts as a thrust spacer on the continuous D-flat.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Now make
Gauge a shaft-land D-flat and its mating gear bore before assembling the stack.
:::
